_readme: Design tokens for excellenttilingservices.com and its house brand. Source of truth for colour, type and spacing. `python3 brand/build.py` writes theme/assets/ets-tokens.css (loaded last in theme/layout/theme.liquid, so these values win over the older :root blocks in ets-2026.css and ets-premium.css) and brand/email.css (paste into Shopify notification / Klaviyo templates). Values match the live 'ETS 2026 – Premium' look; the house brand uses the same system, not a second one.

brand.name: HOUSE_BRAND_TBC
brand.vendor_note: Set the brand name here once chosen; it is the product vendor and the collection title. Never show the manufacturer's name.

finish._note: Swatch colours for the five tapware finishes. Keys are the handleized Finish option values; used by sections/ets-finishes.liquid and for the shopify--color-pattern swatch entries.

font.serif: 'Instrument Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Georgia, serif
